Class AStarPathfinder

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.spatial.AStarPathfinder
public class AStarPathfinder extends Object
A* Pathfinding implementation with Jump Point Search optimization. Finds optimal paths through the terrarium avoiding obstacles.

Features:

  • 3D grid-based pathfinding
  • Terrain-aware obstacle detection
  • Path caching with TTL for performance
  • Configurable heuristic (Euclidean, Manhattan, Chebyshev)

Algorithm credit: Peter Hart, Nils Nilsson, Bertram Raphael (1968)

JPS optimization credit: Daniel Harabor, Alban Grastien (2011)

Author:
Gemini AI Assistant, Silvère Martin-Michiellot
